mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MUSIC_POST ( MUSIC_POST_ID, USER_ID, MUSIC_POST_TITLE, MUSIC_POST_TEXT, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_ID, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_MUSIC_POST.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{musicPostTitle}, #{musicPostText}, SYSDATE, #{createdId}, SYSDATE, #{updatedId} )

INSERT INTO TB_MUSIC_LIST ( MUSIC_LIST_ID, MUSIC_POST_ID, MUSIC_ID, MUSIC_TITLE, MUSIC_SINGER, MUSIC_IMAGE_PATH, MUSIC_PREVIEW_URL, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_ID, UPDATED_DATE, UPDATED_ID ) VALUES ( SEQ_MUSIC_LIST.NEXTVAL, #{musicPostId}, #{musicId}, #{musicTitle}, #{musicSinger}, #{musicImagePath}, #{musicPreviewUrl}, SYSDATE, #{createId}, SYSDATE, #{updatedId} )
mapper.select:
SELECT p.MUSIC_POST_ID AS musicPostId, p.USER_ID AS userId, p.MUSIC_POST_TITLE AS musicPostTitle, p.MUSIC_POST_TEXT AS musicPostText, p.CREATE_ID AS createId, p.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, p.UPDATED_ID AS updatedId, p.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate,
(SELECT l.MUSIC_IMAGE_PATH FROM TB_MUSIC_LIST l WHERE l.MUSIC_POST_ID = p.MUSIC_POST_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS firstImagePath
FROM TB_MUSIC_POST p ORDER BY p.MUSIC_POST_ID DESC

SELECT p.MUSIC_POST_ID AS musicPostId, p.USER_ID AS userId, u.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname, p.MUSIC_POST_TITLE AS musicPostTitle, p.MUSIC_POST_TEXT AS musicPostText, p.CREATE_ID AS createId, p.CREATE_DATE AS createDate, p.UPDATED_ID AS updatedId, p.UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate
FROM TB_MUSIC_POST p JOIN TB_USER u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.MUSIC_POST_ID = #{musicPostId}

SELECT MUSIC_LIST_ID AS musicListId, MUSIC_POST_ID AS musicPostId, MUSIC_ID AS musicId, MUSIC_TITLE AS musicTitle, MUSIC_SINGER AS musicSinger, MUSIC_IMAGE_PATH AS musicImagePath, MUSIC_PREVIEW_URL AS musicPreviewUrl, CREATE_ID AS createId, CREATE_DATE AS createDate, UPDATED_ID AS updatedId, UPDATED_DATE AS updatedDate FROM TB_MUSIC_LIST WHERE MUSIC_POST_ID = #{musicPostId} ORDER BY MUSIC_LIST_ID
